controllerType: C5C overlock sewing machine panel V0.4
type: Overlock / serger machine (包缝机) controller with electric presser foot lift motor and IoT
source: C5C包缝机面板操作说明书V0.4_20250720_中英文.pdf (V0.4, 2025-07-20, bilingual)
note: C5C is an earlier version of the C7-A controller family (V0.4 vs C7-A V1.3). Key similarities to C7-A: (1) Electric servo presser foot lift motor with dedicated error codes E31-E43/E57 and process params U33-U111; (2) IoT/WiFi networking with serial number setting (P116, sections 2.15-2.17); (3) Short thread sensor (U21/U22); (4) Extended P73 factory speed presets (0-7); (5) Same 3 sewing modes (full auto/semi-auto/full computer). Key difference from C7-A: C5C has 14 buttons — no dedicated Suction button (C7-A has 15 buttons with suction as button 14). In C5C, P46 suction adjustment is accessed via the Trimmer parameter button (button 8) when P94=8. Sensor button in C5C is button 14 (vs button 15 in C7-A). Error codes and warning codes are identical to C7-A. Parameters are largely identical to C7-A; see C7-A.json for full details. Monitoring is identical to C7-A (M0-M39).

buttons.name: Up (+) Speed+
buttons.description: Increase speed (+100 RPM); increase parameter value

buttons.name: Down (-) Speed-
buttons.description: Decrease speed (-100 RPM); decrease parameter value

buttons.name: Right (>) LED
buttons.description: Control machine head LCD light brightness (6 levels cycling, one is off); navigate parameter right

buttons.name: Sewing mode button
buttons.description: Change sewing mode (cycles Full Auto/Semi-Auto/Full Computerized)

buttons.name: Presser foot lifter function button
buttons.description: Cycles between: adjust foot height / adjust presser foot mode. Up/down adjusts current parameter. In height mode: 5th/6th digital tube shows foot height in mm.

buttons.name: Trimmer parameter setting button
buttons.description: When P94=8: enters P46 continuous suction adjustment. When P94=6 or 7: enters P07 trim mode and U25 trim length adjustment. Note: this button serves the suction function that C7-A button 14 (Suction) handles — C5C has no dedicated suction button.

buttons.name: Reset button
buttons.description: Long press 2s: restore user saved parameters. Long press Left+Right 2s: restore factory and linked params.

buttons.name: Front cutting line plus (+)
buttons.description: Increase front cut line length parameter value

buttons.name: Forward cutting line minus (-)
buttons.description: Decrease front cut line length parameter value

buttons.name: Post-cut wire plus (+)
buttons.description: Increase post-cut wire length parameter value

buttons.name: Post-cut wire minus (-)
buttons.description: Decrease post-cut wire length parameter value

buttons.name: Sensor button
buttons.description: Short press: switch fabric type (cycles H=normal/S=mesh/A=thin). Long press 1.5s: sensor auto calibration.

parameterEntry.userParams: Long press P for 1.5s → enter user parameter mode. Left/right choose parameter. Up/down modify value. Press P to confirm and save. 10s without press: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.technicianParams: Press P + Presser Foot Lifter button simultaneously for 1.5s → shows P26. Navigate and modify same as user params. 10s timeout.
parameterEntry.processParams: Press P + Down button for 1.5s → shows U1. Navigate and modify same as above. 10s timeout.
parameterEntry.systemParams: Press P + Up button for 1.5s → R&D parameter password input. Enter password. Navigate by right button to find param. Modify up/down. Press P briefly to save.
parameterEntry.monitoring: Press P + Right button → enter monitoring interface. Left/right adjust monitoring items. Press P to enter current monitoring value. Short press P to exit.
parameterEntry.speedAdjust: In standby: up/down buttons adjust max speed ±100 RPM. Press P to save. 10s no button: exits without saving.
parameterEntry.frontCutLineAdjust: When P94=8: press front cut button → modifies P30. When P94=6 or 7, U24=0: press front cut → modifies P27. When P94=6/7, U24=1: press → modifies U104. Use front cut +/- buttons to adjust. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.backCutLineAdjust: When P94=8: press back cut button → modifies P31. When P94=6 or 7, P32=0: press → modifies P28. When P94=6/7, P32=1: press → modifies P50. Use back cut +/- buttons. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.suctionParamAdjust: In C5C (no dedicated Suction button): short press Trimmer parameter button when P94=8 → modifies P46 (feeding and suction mode). This is different from C7-A which has a dedicated suction button. Up/down to change value. Press P to save.
parameterEntry.buttonLock: Set P62=1 to lock. Long press Trimmer parameter button for 1.5s to unlock.
parameterEntry.shortThreadModeSwitch: Long press Sensor button for 1.5s (in C5C, sensor button is #14) → toggle front/back short thread trimmer on/off.
parameterEntry.sensorAutoCalibration: Long press Sensor button (button 14) for 1.5s → sensor auto calibration. Shows OK if successful.
parameterEntry.iotSerialNumber: Enter R&D params (P+Up). Navigate to P116 → set to 1 → save. Panel enters IoT serial number setting. Set 11-digit serial. P+Trimmer button to save. Short press P to exit without saving.
parameterEntry.iotNetworkErrorCheck: A-13: panel disconnects from IoT collector (>1 min). A-11: collector/gateway disconnect. A-12: gateway/server disconnect. View through M15.
parameterEntry.restoreFactory: Long press Reset 2s: restore user saved params. Long press Left+Right 2s: restore factory params. Not restored: P66/P67/P68 adapter duty cycle, P73 factory speed, P90 monitoring enable, P94/P95 model selection, P103 force electric presser foot.

sewingModes.note: Same 3 modes as C5/C7-A. P5 selects mode. Switching modes restores that mode's saved values.

errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or rotates with difficulty. Check motor plug and motor sensor connection. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.
Check voltage is normal. Try factory reset or restart. Call 4008876858 if unresolved.

Check if presser foot is back to correct position. Press P button to clear E06 after presser foot returns to position. Temporarily set P57=0 if needed.
Check if sewing table is back to correct position. Temporarily set P58=0.

errorCodes.solution: Check if needle bar cover is back to correct position. Temporarily set P59=0.

errorCodes.description: Foot motor find first position abnormally
errorCodes.solution: Check if machine head is stuck or difficult to turn. Check motor plug and encoder connector.
Check power supply voltage. Try factory reset or restart.
Check if encoder grating is dusty or damaged. Turn off and restart.

errorCodes.description: Lack of phase in foot motor or IGBT
errorCodes.solution: Check power line of foot motor. Check electronic control hardware drive circuit. Turn off and restart.

errorCodes.description: Counting counts in descending order full
errorCodes.solution: Press P button to clear, or set P71 parameter to 5.

alarmCodes.solution: Upgrade electronic control and panel programs to matching programs.

alarmCodes.solution: Check IoT collector and gateway connection.

alarmCodes.solution: Check if connection between panel and collector is normal.
Check oil level of sewing machine.

troubleshooting.issue: P46 suction mode adjustment (no dedicated suction button in C5C)
troubleshooting.cause: C5C has 14 buttons — no button 14 suction button as in C7-A
troubleshooting.solution: When P94=8, press Trimmer parameter button (button 8) to enter P46 adjustment mode. Up/down to change value. Press P to save. This is different from C7-A where button 14 is dedicated suction button.

troubleshooting.issue: Sensor calibration (how to trigger with C5C buttons)
troubleshooting.cause: C5C has sensor button as button 14 (vs button 15 in C7-A)
troubleshooting.solution: Long press button 14 (Sensor button) for 1.5s to trigger auto calibration.

troubleshooting.cause: IoT module must be physically connected; P116 must be set to 1
troubleshooting.solution: Enter R&D params (P+Up button), navigate to P116, set to 1, save briefly. Follow on-screen prompts to enter 11-digit serial number. Save with P+Trimmer button.
